info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Customer Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Customer Proposition Lookup API enables users to access detailed customer propositions based on specific parameters. This operation retrieves relevant product offerings and services tailored to the customer profile identified by the parameter provided. Typical consumers include banking applications and customer management systems seeking to enhance user experience with personalized offerings. Developers can utilize this API to integrate customer-centric features and improve decision-making processes across banking services.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific customer proposition using its unique identifier. It is essential for accessing customer-centric offerings and can be used to support client-facing applications.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving details about a specific customer proposition. It includes all necessary parameters to identify and fetch the required information for the customer with ID CUST-100045.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the customer proposition data.

GetCustomerManagementByParam1Request.description: A JSON string representing the request body for customer proposition operations in the customer management system.
